ev.q: During November 28–December 7, PHR 6/5S in southeast Texas reported 50 outbreak-associated norovirus cases from six counties.
Among the 50 outbreak-associated cases among persons who lived within PHR 6/5S, the median age was 54 years
diarrhea was reported by 48 of 50 (96%) patients and vomiting by 42 (84%)
41 (82%) of the ill persons in Texas lived in Galveston County
diarrhea was reported by 48 of 50 (96%) patients and vomiting by 42 (84%)
An outbreak-associated case was defined as the onset of diarrhea, nausea, or vomiting within 72 hours after consumption of oysters

methods_quotes.q: Restaurant address was used as a proxy in cases for which the patient’s home address was not available.
